verifications.claim: The 2027 Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) is projected to be around 2.8% based on early 2026 data.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: TSCL kept its 2027 COLA forecast unchanged... at 2.8% following the release of the March inflation report (R1); "TSCL predicts that Social Security’s 2027 Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) will be 2.8%" based on latest CPI data April 10 (R3, R4); TSCL predicts 2.8% based on March inflation data (R5); TSCL estimates 2.8% (R6); TSCL projects 2.8% (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state TSCL's projection of 2.8% for 2027 COLA based on early 2026 (March/April) CPI data.

verifications.claim: The 2027 Social Security COLA projection of 2.8% would match the 2026 increase.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the same as the 2026 COLA of 2.8%" (R3, R4, R5); TSCL estimates 2.8% bump... same as 2026 COLA (R6); exact level of the 2026 benefit increase (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the 2.8% 2027 projection matches the 2026 COLA of 2.8%.

verifications.claim: A 2.8% increase would bring an average retired worker's monthly benefit up from $2,024.77 to $2,081.46.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Exact figures for average retired worker's benefit increase under 2.8% COLA match precisely across sources.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Mary Johnson... projection to 3.2%... due to... Iran war... crude oil prices and energy expenses (R1); Mary Johnson... 3.2%... rising gasoline prices... oil prices (R5); Johnson predicts 3.2%... jump in gasoline prices (R6); Mary Johnson anticipates 3.2% (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly cite 3.2% estimate range due to energy/oil volatility from Iran war.

verifications.claim: Key 2027 COLA forecast details are as of April 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Forecasts explicitly based on March/April 2026 CPI data releases, aligning with April 2026 timing.

Energy prices overall rose 10.9% (R5); Johnson predicts 3.2%... jump in gasoline prices (R6); Mary Johnson anticipates the 2027 raise will be 3.2% (R8)

verifications.claim: A 2.8% raise would provide approximately $56.69 more per month for the average retiree.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Exact $56.69 monthly increase for average retired worker (synonymous with average retiree here) under 2.8% COLA.

verifications.claim: Key drivers of the 2027 COLA forecast include inflation data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, particularly in food and medical care.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: monthly inflation reports by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (R1); Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released the March Consumer Price Index (R5, R6); monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics... prices in some areas, especially for food and medical care, remain stubbornly high (R9)
verifications.reasoning: BLS CPI data drives forecasts (CLEAR), but 'particularly food and medical care' is broader/less precise; key recent driver is energy, though food/medical noted as high for seniors.

verifications.claim: 57.6% of seniors report having to skip medical services to cut costs.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source mentions 57.6% or any specific percentage of seniors skipping medical services.

verifications.claim: The official 2027 COLA percentage will not be finalized until mid-October 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: still six months away from the Social Security Administration announcing the 2027 COLA (R1); official 2027 COLA... until mid-October 2026 (R5); expected to announce in mid-October (R6); SSA won't reveal... until mid-October (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state official announcement in mid-October 2026.

verifications.claim: The official 2027 COLA percentage is based on inflation data for the third quarter (July, August, September) of 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: trailing 12-month readings ending in July, August, and September (the third quarter) (R1); third quarter of the year—July, August, and September (R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Exact description of Q3 (July-Aug-Sep) CPI-W data for 2027 COLA matches sources.
